design.purpose: A drained outdoor planter for herbs or flowers, for one person to use on a patio.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Cut a 58 cm base; keep the 61.4 cm offcut.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Cut two 58 cm sides; keep the 3.4 cm offcut.
Place the narrow board flat for cutting.
Cut two 16 cm ends; keep the 87.4 cm offcut.
Sand every cut edge until smooth.
Lay the 58 × 20 cm base flat.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the 16 cm left end between the sides.
Fit the 16 cm right end between the sides.
Clamp the front-left corner square.
Drill pilot holes at the marked front-left sites.
Drive screws through the front into the left end.
Drill pilot holes at the front-right sites.
Drive screws through the front into the right end.
Drill pilot holes at the back-left sites.
Drive screws through the back into the left end.
Drill pilot holes at the back-right sites.
Drive screws through the back into the right end.
Drill upward pilot holes through base into front side.
Drive screws up through base into front side.
Drill upward pilot holes through base into back side.
Drive screws up through base into back side.
Drill upward pilot hole through base into left end.
Drive a screw up through base into left end.
Drill upward pilot hole through base into right end.
Drive a screw up through base into right end.
Drill six evenly spaced drainage holes in the base.
Check all corners square and every screw seated.
